title: Locale Tag
description: A well-formed BCP 47 language tag. Senders MUST use the RFC 5646 canonical representation: lower-case language and variants, title-case script, and upper-case region (for example `en-US`, `zh-Hant-TW`, or `x-private`). The schema pattern enforces canonical casing and extension structure for commonly used tags; conforming receivers additionally validate the complete RFC 5646 grammar and registry rules. Receivers MUST reject invalid or non-canonical tags rather than silently normalizing them.
